title: Polish shift identity and review readability
summary: Shift identity now keeps its personality without sacrificing readability, while the pending seventh-nurse review is clearer and easier to act on.
changes: Shared shift names now use neutral high-contrast text, while the chosen shift accent is reserved for the icon, border and subtle surface tint.
Team Chat gives the shared shift icon a fixed identity stage and more breathing room so the icon can never crowd the shift name on phone screens.
Pending seventh-nurse review cards now use dark primary copy with amber only as an emphasis cue, fixing the washed-out yellow text.
